why_agent_cannot: confirm the domain against the project's own profile before touching it (forensics flags it)
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://vaultstreet.fun/whitelist   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: Open vaultstreet.fun/whitelist and sign in with X. The site says: "We only read your name, username and profile picture."
Like, repost and comment on the pinned post: "Interact with our pinned post on X."
"Post a tweet, thread or art about Vault Street and tag" its account @VaultStreet_rh, then paste the link to your post.

The game opens on 22 October at 17:00 UTC: "Open vaultstreet.fun/play, tap Connect wallet and sign a free message." Then you buy a bank, which the game calls a Treasury: "Pick one of 5 Treasuries ($2 to $45). It's your bank, yours forever, one per wallet."
